name: Swanna
description: Swanna, the White Bird Pokémon, and the evolved form of Ducklett. A Water and Flying type.
pokedex_entries: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.
Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
